morphic lowers an API spec into Morphic IR.

Usage:
  morphic [flags]
  morphic [command]

Available Commands:
  compile     lower an API spec (OpenAPI 3.x) into Morphic IR JSON
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  help        show help for a command
  validate    check an API spec and report its diagnostics, writing no IR

Flags:
  -h, --help      help for morphic
  -v, --version   version for morphic

Use "morphic [command] --help" for more information about a command.
